Sample $T_i$ using the normalized coordinates: $v_i = T_i.\text{SampleLevel}(\text{sampler\_linear\_clamp}, n, 0)$.
**Pack Channels:** Assign the sampled values to the corresponding channels of $U[x, y, z]$.
**Finalize:** Write the packed texture to GPU memory.
